intro: Show component parts inside each category bucket. StackedBarChart is a dedicated entry that applies the BarChart stacking behavior by default.
useCases: Revenue split by product across months.
Completed versus pending work by team.

faqs.question: Why use StackedBarChart instead of BarChart with stacked?
faqs.answer: Use StackedBarChart when stacking is the primary chart type you want to expose from an entry or CLI vendor command.

faqs.question: Can series customize stack groups?
faqs.answer: The component applies one shared stack by default through the BarChart implementation; use BarChart directly for more specialized grouped stacking.

sections.heading: What it does
sections.body:
Stacks each series into the same category bar with shared grid, axis, legend, and tooltip controls.

It uses the same appearance and density variants as BarChart.

sections.heading: Data shape
sections.body: Rows hold category labels in `xKey`; numeric fields referenced by `series.dataKey` become stacked segments.

sections.heading: Accessibility
sections.body:
Use legends and tooltips with explicit series names.

Avoid too many stacked segments when comparisons need precision.

sections.heading: Next.js integration notes
sections.body: Import from `@zentauri-ui/zentauri-components/charts/stacked-bar` inside client components when interaction is required.
